title: kbmon's session silence metric and alert cover every live session, past the 30 kept rows, and can be narrowed to workers
goal: kbmon.sessions.silent counts every live session, not only the 30 rows SESSIONS_KEPT keeps (newest first), and the point carries the role so an alert rule can fire for workers only. Found by the SP-hxxn6fnv review (two S3 gaps on ST-xvdk32ag).

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import mon_sessions as m;print(m.SESSIONS_KEPT);import inspect;s=inspect.getsource(m);sys.exit(0 if "silent_all" in s or "sorted(" in s and "silent_s" in s and "reverse=True" in s else 1)
